label: Schichten
research: Planday / Deputy / When I Work / Papershift: managers plan on a week grid (rows = people or positions, an 'open shifts' row, colour = coverage), a shift opens a side panel with who is on it, applications to approve and a delete in its menu. Staff use the phone app: the home screen is the next shift as a big card with one 'Clock in' button, then upcoming shifts and an 'Open shifts' list to claim; the time clock and shift check-in are the same button. Timesheets: a list per pay period with hours vs target and an 'Approve' step (approve all, with a count), corrections in a small sheet. Taken: Plan · Meine as views of one area (Meine = the staff home: Jetzt card with one big Einstempeln/Ausstempeln button, then Meine Schichten, Offene Schichten, Zeiten), the shift sheet opens on its Besetzung (assign / accept / clock as immediate actions, delete in ⋯), Stunden with month in the toolbar, Stats and 'Alle freigeben' (count in the confirm), positions/series/team under the gear.

navRedesign.sidebar: Schichten = Plan · Stunden. Plan (/shifts, permission shifts.view or shifts.self) opens the week plan; people with only shifts.self land on /shifts/me. 'Meine' is a <Segments> view on Plan (/shifts/me keeps its URL; Start keeps its 'Meine Schichten' card). Einstellungen (/shifts/settings, gear: true) holds Team (row › /shifts/team, also gear: true for ⌘K and Settings › Bereiche), Positionen and Wiederkehrende Schichten. /shifts/setup keeps redirecting.
navRedesign.label: Plan (not Übersicht); one word for the time clock: Einstempeln / Ausstempeln (free time and a shift's check-in are the same action, 'Einchecken' stays Einlass); 'Beschäftigung' for the employment kind everywhere (was 'Art' on the team).
